# Scorecard

<!-- generated by tools/scorecard.js from lab/misses.json and lab/ff2-misses.json; do not edit by hand -->

Measured with version 1.32.1 in a real Chrome against the local test lab in `lab/`: 36 ways a pretend social network follows a visitor (T), and 10 ways of a hidden collector behind each site's own address (H).
Still following you at the end, at Strongest with no press: 7 of the 35 T ways built and 4 of 10 H; with every question answered yes: 5 and 4.
The H ways are stopped from the moment the cleaner has seen the same code on two sites; the first contact always gets through.
